title: ISO 5817:2023 — Fusion-welded joints — Quality levels for imperfections
locator: Quality levels B, C and D for imperfections in fusion-welded joints in steel, nickel, titanium and their alloys, excluding beam welding; applies to specified joint types and material thickness ≥0.5 mm; metallurgical aspects such as grain size and hardness are outside its scope.
notes: 质量等级必须由设计/合同基于载荷、疲劳、腐蚀和制造要求指定；质量等级不自动确定NDT方法、检测比例或NDT验收等级。标准全文未下载/归档。
